headline: Israel moves to formally recognize Armenian WWI deaths as a genocide
context: Israel's Cabinet approved a proposal to designate violence against Armenians by the Ottoman Empire during World War I as a genocide. The step reflects deteriorating ties between Israel and Turkey.

sources.name: NPR
